scope: Integrated MRI physiological measurement: parsing, recording QC, offline pulse-marker comparison, audited acquisition-window export and aggregate reporting.

archive.duration_interpretation: Whole-record durations include non-scan periods and low-quality segments; they are not quality-accepted MRI measurement minutes.

recording_quality.respiratory_rule_update: Constant intervals longer than five seconds trigger WARN, changing one former OK verdict without changing samples or event-comparison measurements.

audited_run_export.onset_source: Externally audited onset supplied by private manifest; no automatic DICOM onset reconstruction or inferred MRI TTL.
audited_run_export.sample_spacing_assumption: Uniform sampling between MDH clock endpoints.

expanded_offline_ppg_evaluation.interpretation: Marker agreement depends on the matching window. The narrower left boundary is near systematic marker-relative offsets; unmatched pairs are not independently established missed heartbeats.

task_event_alignment.status: Pending task event logs and verified clock/trigger mapping.

historical_detector_benchmark.historical_footer_discrepancy_cause: Unresolved; current complete recordings contain the endpoints, and historical input equivalence is not established.

next_steps: Establish valid segment duration within audited MRI acquisition windows.
Add independent event annotation and appropriate reference measurements.
Validate prospective streaming and acquisition-to-output timing.
